lines.en: Hi! This is English Lab, your English website. In this video, you will see where to find your work, how a Learning Situation works, and how to move around the website.
lines.ca: Hola! Això és English Lab, la teva web d'anglès. En aquest vídeo veuràs on trobar la teva feina, com funciona una Learning Situation i com moure't per la web.

lines.en: On the home page, click your course: 2 ESO or 4 ESO. Sign in with your school email and the password your teacher gave you. Forgot your password? Ask your teacher.
lines.ca: A la pàgina d'inici, clica el teu curs: 2 ESO o 4 ESO. Entra amb el correu de l'institut i la contrasenya que et va donar el professor. Has oblidat la contrasenya? Demana-la al professor.

lines.en: After you sign in, you go to your board, My activities. This is your starting point every day. If your route is Starter or Base, your board is in Catalan.
lines.ca: Quan entres, vas al teu tauler, Les meves activitats. És el teu punt de partida cada dia. Si la teva ruta és Starter o Base, el tauler és en català.

lines.en: At the top, you have your Learning Situations. Click a green button to go to one.
lines.ca: A dalt hi ha les teves Learning Situations. Clica un botó verd per anar-hi.

lines.en: Then, My points. You get points when you answer well in class. If you do all your work, you also get a bonus on your term grade.
lines.ca: Després, Els meus punts. Guanyes punts quan respons bé a classe. Si fas tota la feina, també tens un bonus a la nota del trimestre.

lines.en: If you have late work, a red box tells you. Click Do it now to finish it.
lines.ca: Si tens feina endarrerida, un requadre vermell t'ho diu. Clica Fes-la ara per acabar-la.

lines.en: When your teacher presents in class, a Join the class button appears here. And when your exam results are ready, a message tells you.
lines.ca: Quan el professor fa una presentació a classe, aquí apareix el botó Entra a la classe. I quan tens els resultats de l'examen, un missatge t'avisa.

lines.en: Here you see your route: Starter, Base, Core or Plus. Your teacher sets it. Do you think another route is better for you? Click Ask to change route, choose one, say why, and send it. Your teacher will answer.
lines.ca: Aquí veus la teva ruta: Starter, Base, Core o Plus. La posa el professor. Creus que una altra ruta et va millor? Clica Demana canviar de ruta, tria'n una, explica per què i envia-ho. El professor et respondrà.

lines.en: My week plan shows what we do in class and what you have to do every week, and the date of the exam. If you miss a class, check it here.
lines.ca: El meu pla setmanal mostra què fem a classe i què has de fer cada setmana, i la data de l'examen. Si no has pogut venir a classe, mira-ho aquí.

lines.en: Open The whole LS plan to see every week of the Learning Situation: what we do in class and the activities to do, with their dates.
lines.ca: Obre The whole LS plan per veure totes les setmanes de la Learning Situation: què fem a classe i les activitats que has de fer, amb les dates.

lines.en: The purple My week button is on every page. Click it to see this week's activities and what is still to do.
lines.ca: El botó lila My week és a totes les pàgines. Clica'l per veure les activitats d'aquesta setmana i què et queda per fer.

lines.en: Lower down, you see all the learning paths of the Learning Situation, with their activities and your progress. A green Open button takes you there. A grey one means it is not open yet.
lines.ca: Més avall veus tots els learning paths de la Learning Situation, amb les activitats i el teu progrés. Un botó verd Obre t'hi porta. Si és gris, encara no està obert.

lines.en: Click Summary of my criteria to see how you are doing in each skill.
lines.ca: Clica Resum dels meus criteris per veure com vas en cada competència.

lines.en: Now, let's move around. On your board, the menu on the left has My activities, your course, your Learning Situations and English Lab.
lines.ca: Ara, movem-nos per la web. Al tauler, el menú de l'esquerra té Les meves activitats, el teu curs, les teves Learning Situations i English Lab.

lines.en: On the other pages, the menu is at the top. Click Learning Situations to see the ones of your course. On a phone, tap Menu.
lines.ca: A les altres pàgines, el menú és a dalt. Clica Learning Situations per veure les del teu curs. Al mòbil, toca Menu.

lines.en: This is a Learning Situation. At the top, you see your challenge: the final product you will make, often in a group.
lines.ca: Això és una Learning Situation. A dalt veus el teu repte: el producte final que faràs, sovint en grup.

lines.en: The tabs show more: what you will learn, the learning paths, the language you need, and the final product. Here you also have a sample exam to practise, and Reflect.
lines.ca: Les pestanyes en mostren més: què aprendràs, els learning paths, la llengua que necessites i el producte final. Aquí també tens un examen de mostra per practicar, i Reflect.

lines.en: Now, open a learning path. The top bar takes you back to your board or to the Learning Situation. Use the list to jump to another learning path.
lines.ca: Ara obre un learning path. La barra de dalt et torna al tauler o a la Learning Situation. Fes servir la llista per saltar a un altre learning path.

lines.en: A learning path has steps, like Recall, Vocabulary, Reading, Listening, Grammar, Writing and Speaking. Do them in order, and read the short instruction first.
lines.ca: Un learning path té passos, com Recall, Vocabulary, Reading, Listening, Grammar, Writing i Speaking. Fes-los en ordre, i llegeix primer la instrucció curta.

lines.en: A step is complete when you get eighty per cent right. Your answers save on their own, so you can stop and continue later.
lines.ca: Un pas està complet quan n'encertes el vuitanta per cent. Les respostes es guarden soles, i pots parar i continuar després.

lines.en: Do it the first time on your own, without notes. Then you can repeat it to practise.
lines.ca: La primera vegada fes-ho sol o sola, sense apunts. Després el pots repetir per practicar.

lines.en: Some activities are submitted only once. When you finish, click Mark as done, and then submit it from your board.
lines.ca: Algunes activitats s'entreguen només una vegada. Quan acabis, clica Marca com a feta i després entrega-la des del tauler.

lines.en: When your teacher corrects or answers your work, a message tells you. Click it to read the correction at the top of that step.
lines.ca: Quan el professor et corregeix o et respon una feina, un missatge t'avisa. Clica'l per llegir la correcció a dalt d'aquell pas.

lines.en: Recall checkpoints are short quizzes between learning paths. Read the rules, tick the box and click Start. You see one question at a time, with a timer, and you can't go back. Don't leave the page, or your answers are sent.
lines.ca: Els recall checkpoints són qüestionaris curts entre learning paths. Llegeix les normes, marca la casella i clica Comença. Veus una pregunta cada vegada, amb un temps, i no pots tornar enrere. No surtis de la pàgina, o s'enviaran les respostes.

lines.en: Do you see This activity is not open yet? Don't worry. Your teacher will open it in class when it is time.
lines.ca: Veus Aquesta activitat encara no està oberta? Tranquil. El professor l'obrirà a classe quan toqui.

lines.en: Something doesn't work? Click the orange Problem button at the bottom. Choose what happened, explain it, and add a screenshot if you can. Your teacher will see it.
lines.ca: Alguna cosa no funciona? Clica el botó taronja Problema, a baix. Tria què ha passat, explica-ho i afegeix-hi una captura si pots. El professor ho veurà.

lines.en: English Lab has extra practice: shadowing, sentence builder, word cards, listening and grammar, and vocabulary games for each Learning Situation. Use it when you want.
lines.ca: English Lab té pràctica extra: shadowing, sentence builder, targetes de paraules, listening i gramàtica, i jocs de vocabulari per a cada Learning Situation. Fes-la servir quan vulguis.

lines.en: That's it! Start on your board, check My week, do the steps in order, and ask your teacher when you need help. Have fun with English Lab!
lines.ca: Ja està! Comença pel tauler, mira My week, fes els passos en ordre i demana ajuda al professor quan la necessitis. Que t'ho passis bé amb English Lab!
